loss_text: JSM fires the base binding on the first press of a double pair; Steam suppresses it. Steam->JSM conversion adds an extra base-keystroke; JSM->Steam loses the first-press echo.
jsm_summary: Single press -> KEY_B; double pair -> KEY_B (first) then KEY_X (second). Base fires on every first press.
steam_summary: Single press -> F12; double pair (90ms gap) -> F7 only, base F12 suppressed entirely.
notes: Steam's Double Tap Time default 190ms; JSM's DBL_PRESS_WINDOW may differ. Comparator must parameterize threshold.
